title: All Fours
author: Miranda July
review: The book is strongest when it makes freedom feel neither heroic nor selfish, but like an ongoing technical problem: how to construct a life capacious enough for contradiction.

title: Slow Days, Fast Company
author: Eve Babitz
review: Effortlessness here is a highly engineered style. Babitz makes intelligence look like appetite and criticism look like gossip, which is part of the pleasure.
